title: Agent XYZ
tagline: A platform to build, create and compose AI agents built on Galadriel to carry out several tasks
description:
The project combines the power of Galadriel network for developing on AI agents

The core of the project is a platform that consists of multiple AI agents developed on the Galadriel network. These AI agents can then be used to compose Super Agents, so to speak that work with each other.

The initial developed agent is a Story writing assistant, wher e the user interface is the terminal to run the application
how_its_made:
The core technologies used to develop the project are:
1. Galadriel network - The smart contracts are used to create several agents that can communicate with OpenAI & Grok to perform several tasks.
2. Hardhat has been used for smart contract deployment.

The galadriel network Oracles are used to communicate natural language intent of customers to LLMs. The Oracle response is displayed in the terminal.
